notes: Population: WorldPop 100m gridded raster (2020). Employment: two real published totals, combined. NCT Delhi's own portion uses SHRUG's 2013 Economic Census total (`ec13_emp_all`), filtered by the 2011 Census state code embedded in each shrid2 identifier so bordering Haryana/UP economic activity isn't counted as Delhi's; that one real total is spread across Delhi's 290 real wards (DMC, NDMC, Delhi Cantonment Board, each numbering wards independently) using each ward's own real 2011 Census worker count (Table PCA-TV, residence-based) as a spatial weight; 55 wards have no matching Census figure, of which 27 fall back to an OSM-landuse-derived proxy weight and 28 remain a documented residual gap. The Haryana/UP portion of the bounding box (Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad) uses SHRUG's subdistrict-level Economic Census product instead, which does not collapse into a single figure the way Delhi's does (real, distinct per-subdistrict totals). Within both, jobs are placed using OSM landuse-polygon type (residential/commercial/retail/etc.) as a generic density prior. Commute pairs: doubly-constrained gravity model, decay exponent calibrated against Census 2011 Table B-28 distance-band data for NCT Delhi. Data vintages: WorldPop 2020, SHRUG 2013 Economic Census, Census of India 2011 (Table PCA-TV and Table B-28), OSM extract current as of v1.1.0's build. — Reviewer refinements (2026-09-10): workplace_granularity re-ruled adm2 — the measured workplace content is a single SHRUG EC13 city-wide total spanning the whole map (single units of ~4.5M-19M population: KMC ~4.5M, GHMC/Chennai Corp ~7M, BBMP ~8.4M, BMC ~12.4M, NCT Delhi ~19M — at or beyond the riyadh single-governorate scale, and NCT is simultaneously ADM1, the vienna middle-rule shape); the ward-level weights are residence-based Census PCA-TV worker counts, which are not measured workplace grain. Workplace placement re-priced osm_footprints x coarse_sector — the between-ward pattern is residence-weighted (reunion workers-land-where-people-live precedent, softened by a genuine within-ward signal) and the within-ward split is an OSM landuse/type sector prior. od_metric re-ruled prior_informed_synthetic — no per-area in/out commuter totals exist; only the origin marginal is measured (ward residence workers), the destination marginal is the single respread total, and the gravity decay is calibrated to Census 2011 Table B-28 distance bands — a genuinely domestic prior, better than the rung's analogue-country baseline, recorded as such. resident_granularity re-ruled mesh_1km — WorldPop is a modeled disaggregation, not a published census mesh: magnitudes are anchored over large areas but effective resolution after smoothing is on the order of a kilometre (the WorldPop rung, now on record). The honest 'spread evenly' placement answer stands as filed. workplace_count physical_measured CONFIRMED — the Economic Census is a real establishment enumeration (2013 vintage on record). Partial exceptions on record: the NCR satellite portion (Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad) carries real per-subdistrict EC totals — alone it would support a finer workplace grain and a partially measured destination marginal; the floor principle keeps the map at the NCT single-unit ruling. 28 wards remain a documented residual weight gap.
